structuredContent.content:
name: atlas-pilot

# Change-scoped development gate; does not replace the final integrated epic.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: ["pilot-check-*", "genesis-fresh-s4"]
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/atlas-pilot.yml"
      - "modules/atlas/**"
      - "!modules/atlas/docs/design/genesis-chatgpt-results/**"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  pilot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-bun
      - name: Install Atlas dependencies
        working-directory: modules/atlas
        run: npm ci
      - name: Typecheck Atlas
        working-directory: modules/atlas
        run: bun typecheck
      - name: Grouped ownership and existing door regressions
        working-directory: modules/atlas
        run: |
          npx --no-install vitest run \
            packages/knowledge/test/ownership-read.test.ts \
            packages/knowledge/test/ownership-update-plan.test.ts \
            packages/knowledge/test/fastpath-promotion-origin.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-publication.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/genesis-native.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/genesis-native-recovery.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/g3-recovery.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/sidecar.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/identity-schema.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/store-provenance.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/read-provenance-refusal.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/migrate-layout.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-update.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-input.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-observe.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-rebuild.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/wp-10.a3-check.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/governed-promote.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/travel-by-reproof-compose.test.ts \
            packages/adapter-io/test/propose-template.test.ts \
            packages/e2e-blackbox/test/s-sound-default.blackbox.test.ts \
            packages/e2e-blackbox/test/s14-mine.blackbox.test.ts \
            packages/e2e-blackbox/test/s26-symbol-arm.blackbox.test.ts \
            --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=ownership-runtime-results.json
      - name: Probe the new guards against named failing controls
        working-directory: modules/atlas
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, pathlib, subprocess
          probes = [
            ('update-affected-order', 'packages/knowledge/src/ownership/update-plan.ts',
             'affected: affectedOrder', 'affected: order.filter((key) => affected.has(key))',
             'packages/knowledge/test/ownership-update-plan.test.ts', 'UP-24 an unchanged prerequisite', False),
            ('update-input', 'packages/knowledge/src/ownership/update-plan.ts',
             'changes.push({ artifact: key, input: input.key, previous: input.version, observed: captured })', 'void 0',
             'packages/knowledge/test/ownership-update-plan.test.ts', 'UP-2 source drift', False),
            ('update-dependency', 'packages/knowledge/src/ownership/update-plan.ts',
             'if (direct.has(key) || receipts.get(key)!.dependencies.some((dependency) => affected.has(dependency.key)))', 'if (direct.has(key))',
             'packages/knowledge/test/ownership-update-plan.test.ts', 'UP-2 source drift', False),
            ('update-frontier', 'packages/knowledge/src/ownership/update-plan.ts',
             'frontier: [...direct].filter((key) => !receipts.get(key)!.dependencies.some((dependency) => affected.has(dependency.key))).sort()', 'frontier: [...direct].sort()',
             'packages/knowledge/test/ownership-update-plan.test.ts', 'UP-9 simultaneous upstream', False),
            ('update-unavailable', 'packages/knowledge/src/ownership/update-plan.ts',
             'observed.kind === "unavailable" ||', 'false ||',
             'packages/knowledge/test/ownership-update-plan.test.ts', 'UP-7 unavailable observations', False),
            ('need-root', 'packages/knowledge/src/ownership/read.ts',
             '  if (query.need !== undefined && selectedArtifact.artifact.need !== query.need)\n    return hold("ownership-selection", [selected, query.need, selectedArtifact.artifact.need])\n', '',
             'packages/knowledge/test/ownership-read.test.ts', 'RP-1 refuses a need root bound to an artifact declaring another need', False),
            ('current-input', 'packages/knowledge/src/ownership/read.ts',
             'if (!query.historical)', 'if (false)',
             'packages/knowledge/test/ownership-read.test.ts', 'IFIT-4 holds a changed required source', False),
            ('composed-ratify', 'packages/knowledge/src/ratify/fastpath.ts',
             ' && !composed', '',
             'packages/knowledge/test/fastpath-promotion-origin.test.ts', 'IFIT-2 a composed ownership publication', False),
            ('worker-ast', 'packages/cli/src/mine-worker.ts',
             '  await initAst()', '',
             'packages/e2e-blackbox/test/s26-symbol-arm.blackbox.test.ts', 'THE GUARD: every `::` site is visited and seeded', True),
            ('observer-error-as-absent', 'packages/adapter-io/src/ownership-input.ts',
             '} catch { return { kind: "unavailable" } }\n  let after: ReturnType<typeof lstatSync>', '} catch { return { kind: "absent" } }\n  let after: ReturnType<typeof lstatSync>',
             'packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-observe.test.ts', 'HO-04 read errors', False),
            ('observer-members-index-only', 'packages/adapter-io/src/ownership-input.ts',
             '        if (!corroborateCandidateAbsent(raw)) return { kind: "unavailable" }\n        continue\n      }', '        if (!corroborateCandidateAbsent(raw)) return { kind: "unavailable" }\n        effective.push(raw); continue\n      }',
             'packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-observe.test.ts', 'HO-08 unstaged deletion', False),
            ('observer-accept-partial-git', 'packages/adapter-io/src/ownership-input.ts',
             'if (strict.truncated) return { kind: "unavailable" }', 'if (strict.truncated) { }',
             'packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-observe.test.ts', 'HO-10 incomplete Git', False),
            ('rebuild-every-affected', 'packages/adapter-io/src/ownership-rebuild.ts',
             'const precise = ownChanged || depChanged\n    if (!precise) continue', 'const precise = true\n    if (!precise) continue',
             'packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-rebuild.test.ts', 'RB-08 equal result renews', False),
            ('rebuild-return-old-result', 'packages/adapter-io/src/ownership-rebuild.ts',
             'newResults.set(key, resultRef)', 'newResults.set(key, bound.resultRef)',
             'packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-rebuild.test.ts', 'RB-02 source edit', False),
            ('rebuild-body-only-stop', 'packages/adapter-io/src/ownership-rebuild.ts',
             'const depChanged = recipe.required.some((dep) => newResults.get(dep) !== bound.receipt.dependencies.find((dependency) => dependency.key === dep)?.result)',
             'const depChanged = recipe.required.some((dep) => (request.store.get(newResults.get(dep) as Hash) as OwnershipResult).body !== (request.store.get(bound.receipt.dependencies.find((dependency) => dependency.key === dep)?.result as Hash) as OwnershipResult).body)',
             'packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-rebuild.test.ts', 'RB-12 full result identity', False),
            ('rebuild-ignore-direct-child-change', 'packages/adapter-io/src/ownership-rebuild.ts',
             'const precise = ownChanged || depChanged', 'const precise = depChanged',
             'packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-rebuild.test.ts', 'RB-10 parent equality', False),
            ('rebuild-omit-input', 'packages/adapter-io/src/ownership-rebuild.ts',
             'if (!boundKeys.has(input)) return hold("malformed-ownership", [entry.key, input])', 'if (!boundKeys.has(input)) { }',
             'packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-rebuild.test.ts', 'RB-14 an omitted declared input', False),
            ('rebuild-omit-required-edge', 'packages/adapter-io/src/ownership-rebuild.ts',
             'if (requiredSet.size !== recipe.required.length || depKeys.size !== requiredSet.size || [...requiredSet].some((dep) => !depKeys.has(dep)))', 'if (false)',
             'packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-rebuild.test.ts', 'RB-15 an omitted required edge', False),
            ('rebuild-accept-stale-review', 'packages/adapter-io/src/ownership-rebuild.ts',
             '      reviews: evaluated.reviews,',
             '      reviews: bound.receipt.reviews,',
             'packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-rebuild.test.ts', 'RB-13 rejected or unbound', False),
            ('rebuild-skip-preflight', 'packages/adapter-io/src/ownership-rebuild.ts',
             'for (const key of captured.keys()) preflightMap.set(key, request.observe(key))', 'for (const key of captured.keys()) preflightMap.set(key, captured.get(key) as OwnershipInputObservation)',
             'packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-rebuild.test.ts', 'TC-01 drift before', False),
            ('rebuild-skip-final-sweep', 'packages/adapter-io/src/ownership-rebuild.ts',
             '  for (const key of captured.keys()) {\n    const fresh = request.observe(key)\n    if (!sameObservation(captured.get(key), fresh)) return hold("ownership-input-changed", [key])\n  }\n  for (const [dir, listed] of initialMembers) {',
             '  for (const key of captured.keys()) { const fresh = captured.get(key); if (!sameObservation(captured.get(key), fresh)) return hold("ownership-input-changed", [key]) }\n  for (const [dir, listed] of initialMembers) {',
             'packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-rebuild.test.ts', 'TC-03 drift in a reused', False),
            ('rebuild-read-live-path', 'packages/adapter-io/src/ownership-rebuild.ts',
             '    bytes: new Map([...capturedBytes].map(([snapshotKey, snapshotValue]) => [snapshotKey, new Uint8Array(snapshotValue)] as [string, Uint8Array])),',
             '    bytes: new Proxy(new Map<string, Uint8Array>(), { get: (target, prop) => prop === "get" ? ((key: string) => request.readCapturedBytes(key)) : (target as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[prop as string] }),',
             'packages/adapter-io/test/ownership-rebuild.test.ts', 'TC-05 ABA cannot', False),
          ]
          receipts = []
          for name, path, before, after, test, title, compiled in probes:
              source = pathlib.Path(path)
              original = source.read_text()
              if original.count(before) != 1:
                  raise RuntimeError(f'{name}: mutation target absent or ambiguous')
              report = pathlib.Path(f'ownership-probe-{name}.json')
              try:
                  source.write_text(original.replace(before, after))
                  if compiled:
                      subprocess.run(['npm', 'run', 'build'], check=True)
                  run = subprocess.run(['npx', '--no-install', 'vitest', 'run', test, '-t', title, '--reporter=json', '--outputFile=' + str(report)])
                  if not report.is_file():
                      raise RuntimeError(f'{name}: no test report')
                  data = json.loads(report.read_text())
                  failures = [a for suite in data['testResults'] for a in suite['assertionResults'] if a['status'] == 'failed' and title in a['fullName']]
                  if run.returncode == 0 or not failures:
                      raise RuntimeError(f'{name}: named control did not reject the mutant')
                  receipts.append({'probe': name, 'exitCode': run.returncode, 'namedFailures': [a['fullName'] for a in failures]})
              finally:
                  source.write_text(original)
                  if compiled:
                      subprocess.run(['npm', 'run', 'build'], check=True)
          pathlib.Path('ownership-mutation-receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipts, indent=2) + '\n')
          PY
      - name: Generate Atlas boundary from the checked sources
        working-directory: modules/atlas/boundary
        run: bun run generate
      # Raw logs remain in the Actions archive; durable repository receipts record structured verdicts.
      - name: Check repository guards on the candidate
        run: |
          set +e
          bun run check:guards --base origin/dev > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ownership-guards.log" 2>&1
          code=$?
          set -e
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/ownership-guards.log"
          GUARD_EXIT="$code" node --input-type=module -e 'import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs"; writeFileSync("modules/atlas/ownership-guards.json", JSON.stringify({ command: "bun run check:guards --base origin/dev", exitCode: Number(process.env.GUARD_EXIT), candidate: process.env.GITHUB_SHA }) + "\n")'
          exit "$code"
      - name: Preserve exact gate and generated-boundary evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: ownership-runtime-${{ github.sha }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            modules/atlas/ownership-*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ownership-guards.log
            modules/atlas/boundary/src/generated
          retention-days: 7
